title: 36 smash hitz x smash hit (Mashup)
lyrics:
[singer A]
We walked where restless voices rise
Wounded hearts and guarded eyes
They asked if truth was made by will
Or if it stands there, quiet still

[melodic interlude]

[singer B]
look at it, way up there, high in the sky. it's talking to me. i can hear it.
wind is in your favour, timeless. feel the breeze brush past your face, no blinding rays in sight.

[singer A]
Truth in the fire, hope in the flame
Call me to change me, not stay the same
When every road says none is right
I still choose the light, the light, the light
Zynthio light — ¡Elige la luz! I choose the light!

[transition]

[singer B]
i think i might..... i think i may...... yes...... all signs are clear.
its saying ....... SMASH IT go for it, the time is right. finish it! the the time is right now.
soooooo.o.o.o.o SMASH IT!

[singer A]
Love is not soft when the fight runs deep
Michele steps up, she’s ready to leap
Her pickleball way up high in the sky
It’s talking to her, she hears the reply
Wind in her favor, timeless and true
Breeze brushes her face, no blinding rays in view

[instrumental]

[singer B]
perfect timing perfect position, your responcible for the creation of tge perfect smash.
o.o.o.o.o.o. SMASH IT! point over, your in over drive

[singer A]
Truth in the fire, hope in the flame
Call me to change me, not stay the same
When every road says none is right
I still choose the light, the light, the light
Zynthio rising — ¡Elige la luz! I claim the light!
¡SMASH IT! ¡SMASH IT! Point over — she’s in overdrive! ¡Vamos Michele!
